notes.title: Sugoi Adventure! DragonSlayer - coming this Summer!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35308881/2de20143f4a379f8ef662a9a71c9f03e778bf0f2.jpg[/img]

A [b]card game/visual novel [/b]hybrid where you get on a life of fantasy adventure, make decisions, and face the consequences (some of them being beautiful girls). Forge your destiny, and remember to keep all your stats nice and balanced!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936310/Sugoi_Adventure_DragonSlayer/

[b]Get on a quest of your lifetime! [/b]
This kingdom needs a hero, and that's exactly who you happen to be. Make your way to glory!

[b]Maintain your stats! [/b]
Money, health, stress, and fame - will you be able to balance your way through the heroic journey?

[b]Gather your party![/b]
Get yourself some skillful allies! But beware of the temptations along the way...

[b]Get rid of that nasty Dragon! [/b]
Make your daddy proud.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A fun tale of might, magic, and well-built women!
[*] Over 300 adventure cards to go through
[*] Six girls available for romance 💕
[*] A free DLC at launch! (❤️ω❤️*)
[*] Multiple endings
[*] Various achievements
[*] Trading cards - as soon as Steam allows us to add them!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936310/Sugoi_Adventure_DragonSlayer/
